# Erdos.p357 — Erdős problem 357

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/357
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/357.lean`, theorem `erdos_357.parts.i`, AMS 11).

Let $f(n)$ be the maximal $k$ such that there exist integers $1 \le a_1 < \dotsc < a_k \le n$
such that all sums of the shape $\sum_{u \le i \le v} a_i$ are distinct. Is $f(n)=o(n)$?

## Statement
(fun n ↦ (f n : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun n ↦ (n : ℝ))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
